protocol.selection: The parent request fixed these original pilot IDs and all markets before table extraction. This is a retrospective descriptive study, not a prospective preregistration or performance-selected shortlist.
protocol.retain: All pairs and all scenarios, including negative, unavailable and no-observed-crossing outcomes. No performance-based exclusion or replacement.
protocol.comparison: Published full-cohort ranks only within identical asset/date/input/model/anchor contexts; no cross-market pooled winner. Descriptive sample does not estimate general strategy-family superiority.
protocol.writes: Only research-series tables; no source, data, prices, model calls, publication or R4 work.
